claude.finalText:
I replaced the model IDs that no longer work or stop working within 90 days. I didn't run a type-check, build or test, so none of this has been run.

**What broke**
- **Groq:** `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` and `llama-3.1-8b-instant` shut down on 2026-08-16. Groq's [deprecations page](https://console.groq.com/docs/deprecations) lists `openai/gpt-oss-120b` and `openai/gpt-oss-20b` as replacements. Requests using the old IDs now return errors, so the GitHub webhook reply and the AI-config test calls are failing today.
- **OpenAI:** `gpt-4o-2024-08-06` and `gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14` are removed on 2027-01-14, which is 72 days from now. OpenAI's [deprecations page](https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations) names `gpt-6-luna` as the replacement for both.

**What I changed**
- **`lib/ai/modelChoices.ts`:**
  - **Model list:** it now offers `gpt-6-luna`, `openai/gpt-oss-120b` and `openai/gpt-oss-20b`. The plan restrictions are unchanged, so the 20b model is the free-tier one.
  - **`resolveModel`:** I added this helper. It maps the old model IDs to their replacements, so saved configs that still hold an old ID keep working.
- **`lib/ai/modelPromptingService.ts`:**
  - **`resolveModel`:** both chat runners now apply it.
  - **`reasoning_effort: "none"`:** the OpenAI call now sends this. The `gpt-6-luna` docs say `temperature` is rejected unless reasoning effort is `none`, and the default is `medium`.
  - **`as any` cast:** I cast the OpenAI call and its response to `any`. I assumed the installed `openai` 4.x types don't include `"none"` or the new model, but I didn't check.
- **`lib/webhook/promptModel.ts` and `AIConfigurationClient.tsx`:** I swapped the hardcoded `llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, `llama-3.1-8b-instant` (commented-out line only) and `gpt-4o` defaults for the new IDs.

**Other notes**
- Routing in `app/api/prompts/test/route.ts` still works. It sends IDs starting with `gpt-` to OpenAI, and `openai/gpt-oss-*` goes to Groq.
- Pre-existing rows in the database still hold the old IDs. The mapping covers them at call time, but I didn't migrate the stored data.
- Replacement models behave differently from the old ones, so check output quality and token usage.
- Groq's deprecation applies to free and developer tiers only. Enterprise accounts with a committed-spend contract aren't affected.
- I found no other deadlines inside 90 days that affect this repo. The Stripe API version `2025-04-30.basil` and the other SDKs (Octokit, SendGrid, Upstash) showed nothing, though I only searched deprecations for the Groq and OpenAI models.
- The prebuilt `.next/` folder still contains the old IDs. It will update on the next build.

Sources:
- [Groq deprecations](https://console.groq.com/docs/deprecations)
- [OpenAI deprecations](https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations)
- [GPT-6 Luna model page](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-6-luna)

judge.why: Both handle the two model retirements that matter. Only A maps old model IDs stored in saved configs to their replacements, and the Groq models are already shut down, so B leaves those configs failing today. B also adds an unrequired Stripe major upgrade, removes payment_method_types, bumps Upstash and corrupts the lockfile name.
